name: Reagent Pouch (shaman)
summary: Burning Blade cultists in Durotar carry reagents for a shaman's first fire sapta. Telf Joolam uses them with fire tar from Razormane quilboar to make the draught that lets a young shaman see the realm of fire.

sections.title: Components of the Flame
sections.body: Burning Blade cultists carry reagents for a young shaman's first fire sapta. The hermit Telf Joolam uses the powders and oils in their pouches with fire tar from Razormane quilboar. Together, these components make a draught that grants sight into the realm of fire and attunes the shaman to the spirits of flame.

sections.title: Tainted Sources, Pure Vision
sections.body: Burning Blade cultists turn flame toward destruction and fel sorcery, yet the elements in their pouches still belong to heat and combustion. Shaman teach that elemental forces exist in tension: fire creates as well as destroys. A shaman can take the cultists' tools and use those elements to awaken true communion with the spirits.

faq.q: What is the reagent pouch used for?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam uses the reagents to brew a fire sapta. Drinking it grants a shaman visionary sight to seek the elemental spirits and claim the Fire Totem.

faq.q: Where do I find a reagent pouch?
faq.answer: You can recover a pouch from Burning Blade cultists in Dustwind Cave, in the rocky heights northeast of Razor Hill in Durotar.

faq.q: Why does a shaman need warlock reagents?
faq.answer: Burning Blade cultists stock their pouches with ingredients tied to fire magic. Their flame rituals make the reagents useful catalysts for brewing a fire sapta.

angles.text: As a shaman, retrieving the pouch is a rite of passage toward earning your Fire Totem. It teaches that corrupted elemental forces can be reclaimed to serve balance.
As a warlock, you recognize the pouches as sorcerous supplies for fel cultists. Their ritual elements are meant for demonic pyromancy, not communion with nature.
